meta.title: Context Injection Manager
meta.description: See and control everything a new session injects before its first request — prompt sections, runtime contexts, the skill catalog, tool schemas and workspace rules, clustered into suites with one switch per MCP server. v2 adds a content browser with source paths and search highlighting, a cross-session first-turn trend, an event timeline, health checks and per-session cards, each number stating its source and coverage. Presets and a custom prefix/suffix are supported; a policy only applies to sessions created afterwards and every switch is reversible. Entries: the sidebar injection icon (manage / insights / settings), the composer dock chip, the read-only context_injection model tool and the /inject command.
